Name: Baby and Toddler Events
Author: kristinthered
Description:
[size=3]We can all agree that unmodded children in Stardew Valley leave something to be desired. This mod is an attempt to make parenthood a little more enticing for players. [/size]

[size=4][b]Note: all of these events are only applicable for your first child. I am working on creating events for your second (and potentially third and fourth) child. Thank you for your patience![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]MAJOR THANKS TO [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/AirynS]AirynS[/url] FOR ALL OF THEIR HELP WITH CREATING AND CODING THE OVERLAYS!![/b][/size]

[size=5][u]Known/Potential Issues and Notes: 
[/u][/size][size=3]1. Your baby will appear in their crib at 7:00 pm. Your spouse may also still be carrying your baby at that time... so uh please ignore the double baby. It shouldn't last long. 

2. This mod will NOT currently work with any of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Lucypandyleo/mods]Lucypandyleo[/url]﻿'s baby mods; I am hoping to fix that in a future update. ﻿﻿

3. This mod will PARTIALLY work with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36459]Have More Kids[/url]. Again, these events are only for your FIRST baby. Also, changing the stage durations of your baby will trigger events at potentially unwanted times. 

4. I have not tested this mod with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]PolyamorySweet[/url] yet. Your spouse may change or show the wrong portraits throughout the events. 

5. This mod [i]should [/i]work with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18972]Immersive Family[/url] and only overwrite 2 overlapping events. I have not tested this yet. 

6. This mod [i]should [/i]work with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9500]Customizable Baby and Children[/url].

7. This mod [i]should [/i]work with any [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4568]Child To NPC[/url] mods, as long as they turn the toddler into a child after at least 62 days. 

8. Your spouse may try to take your baby to Ginger Island and... let's say leave them in the changing room. Don't worry about it; they have toys in there.[/size]

[size=3]9. This mod [i]should [/i]work with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url]. [/size]

[u][size=4]Version 1.0.0 of the mod includes the following events: [/size][/u]
[spoiler][size=3]1. The farmer and spouse admire their baby. Vanilla spouses will rock the baby, modded spouses will hold the baby.
2. Your baby says their first word! This will always be the player's chosen nickname—you can modify it in your configuration settings. 
3. [Only applicable if the player is married to Sam] Sam plays guitar for your baby. 
4. [Only applicable if the player is married to Abigail] Abigail plays flute for your baby. 
5. Your baby learns to crawl. 
6. Your toddler learns to walk. 
7. Your fussy toddler won't accept their bottle from anyone but you. 
8. Your stinky toddler gets a bath in the sink. 
9. Your toddler meets a pig at Marnie's farm[/size][/spoiler]
[size=3]
Your vanilla spouse will carry your baby around town on non-rainy, non-festival days from 6:00 am to 7:00 pm when they are between the ages of 13 and 55 days. [/size]

[size=4]The spouse schedules are: [/size]
[spoiler][size=3]-- Abigail, Emily, Sam, Sebastian, and Shane carry your baby around town on Mondays and Fridays. 
-- Alex carries your baby around town on Mondays and Sundays. 
-- Elliott, Haley, Harvey, Leah, Maru, and Penny carry your baby around town on Mondays.[/size][/spoiler]


[size=4]Plans for [i]potential [/i]future events and features: [/size]
[spoiler][size=3]-- Baby and toddler checkups at the clinic 
-- Babies/toddlers interact with your pets
-- Babies/toddlers interact with each other 
-- Your spouse introduces babies/toddlers to their family and/or other villagers 
-- Your spouse carries your baby around in their winter outfits 
-- Your spouse takes your baby to Ginger Island 
-- Customization options for the baby carrier, baby, and onesie color[/size][/spoiler]
